text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1934/11 – TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 29, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) AS
AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/09.
Land Min’s Ref No.: 4/3/10/2012/LRB-94.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government has acquired the lands described below and located between Boralesgamuwa-Bellanwila bus route and Boralesgamuwa - Colombo (120) bus route to develop a water reserve and a water tank under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Hundred and eighty five (185) allotments of land in total extent of 34.1488 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 to 54 and Lot No. 56 to 186 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9464 dated 07.07.2015 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Boralesgamuwa in the Grama Niladhari division No. 535 A of Bellanwila in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of Western Province and more fully described as follows:
